result.stdout:
Usage: fdlcleaner mode [arguments]

Mode (required):
  <file>                      FDL file, wildcard FDL spec., or list input file
  help                        Display this help information
  update                      Check for a newer version

  OpenVMS-style logical names may be used in the <file> argument.

Arguments:
  --backup                    Copy altered FDLs to <file>.backup
  --check-key-names           Validate KEY NAME values
  --file-name-map <file>      File with KEY=VALUE map repllace FILE/NAME values
  --indent-with-tabs          If normalizing indentation use tabs
  --no-reindent               Do not normalize indentation
  --no-remove-analysis        Do not remove ANALYSIS sections
  --no-remove-owner           Do not remove FILE OWNER attributes
  --no-remove-protection      Do not remove FILE PROTECTION attributes
  --no-file-name-clean        Do not clean FILE NAME values
  --no-remove-comments        Do not remove comments
  --remove-areas              Remove AREA n sections
  --quiet                     Suppress progress and completion statistics
